content_of_post_to_comment:
This internet addiction has stolen my teenage years from me. Hours ripped away by a simple metal box. High school academic dreams stripped away by a crippling compulsion. Anxiety and depression reinforced by constant comparison. Opportunities and precious moments taken out of my hurting hands. Digital impulses sucking the soul out of me, leaving days repetitive, monotonous and screen based.

Please quit your phone/computer/ipad habits now. Before they come back to bite your back and leave you with nothing but haunting regret about what could've been.
comment: The scary part is how normal it can feel while it's happening. I spent a lot of time thinking I was just “relaxing” online, when I was actually avoiding things that mattered to me. I don't think phones are the enemy, but having no boundaries with them can quietly replace real experiences. Rebuilding attention is a slow process, not a one-day fix.
